review.rationale: The CE-G12 Decision correctly binds the Recommendation chain (reference, SHA-256, review reference, review SHA-256, commit, and remote verification). It binds exactly six evidence artifacts with SHA-256 hashes covering atomic activation, public route validation, and public network path attribution (result + report pairs). It authorizes exactly five target paths for status reconciliation. Historical failures (preflight, route hash, rollback, status sync) are preserved with rewrite-to-pass explicitly forbidden. The current state records successful static activation and deployment without elevating release, standard, production, or offering status (all false/0). Direct-origin is kept false (strict_direct_origin_path_pass: false, public_network_path_classification: LOCAL_SYNTHETIC_DNS_MAPPING_OBSERVED). CE-G13 remains unauthorized (ce_g13_recommendation_creation_in_same_action: false, ce_g13_recommendation_authorized: false, next_action_authorized: false). Validation contract and caps are sufficient with comprehensive stop conditions and fail-closed boundaries. All non-authorizations are complete and authority boundaries are preserved.
